title: 2. CTF Methodology
objective: Study-guide review — ICCS423 v2 — L22: CTF Skills & Exam 3 Prep: 2. CTF Methodology.

blocks.text: A repeatable approach saves time and reduces panic when stuck:
↓ ↓ ↓ ↓ ↓ Recon Find vuln Build PoC Get flag Document ```

items: Read the prompt carefully — challenge description often hints at the technique
Enumerate — gather everything: ports, files, source code, headers, comments, robots.txt, common paths
Identify the vulnerability — match observed behavior to known classes (SQLi? XSS? path traversal?)
Exploit — craft a proof-of-concept that triggers the vuln
Capture flag — extract the flag string
Write-up — document for your team / future-self / blog
Re-read the prompt for hints you missed
Try the simplest possibility (default credentials, public exploit, common paths)
Look at the file/page sources, response headers, cookies
Check if there's a hint mechanism (challenge description, IRC channel)
Move to another challenge — fresh eyes help
